verdict.rationale: The source is public on GitHub. The INSTALL docs explain building it from source with `cargo build --release`, and it is published to crates.io via `cargo install alacritty`, so a user can clearly read and build it. However, no evidence in the pack states which license the code is released under. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
